# Ordinary CMYK pipeline fixtures

These five synthetic native Modular inputs cover integer CMYK, mixed alpha,
associated alpha and a shifted black/alpha grid across a group boundary.
Their compressed references contain interleaved big-endian sRGB samples.
The manifest records input, reference, profile and LittleCMS hashes.

`source.icc` is extracted from the existing
`tests/fixtures/jpegxl/m10-level10/cmyk-layers.jxl` fixture. That fixture comes
from the CC0 `cmyk_layers` case in libjxl/conformance revision
`4bf053529c7cefd2951be453475bb3dccc7e7be8`. The synthetic samples and encoded
inputs are generated by the first-party TypeScript fixture generator. They
contain test data and an ICC profile, with no codec implementation or oracle
binary bundled in the fixtures.

Regenerate with Node 24, Bun, and the pinned LittleCMS 2.17 development oracle:

```sh
node benchmark/jpegxl/generate-cmyk-pipeline-fixtures.ts
```

LittleCMS evaluates the source complements after associated-alpha straightening
and one UInt16 rounding. Shifted extra channels are constant, so the reference
does not qualify every nonconstant shifted reconstruction. Color and alpha
tolerances are recorded separately.
